en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of an industrial waterfront complex on a lake or river. In the foreground is choppy water; on the shore stand several long, low factory buildings with gabled roofs, tall windows, and a central chimney. To the left is a large A‑frame crane structure by the water. Behind the factory rises a forested hillside with conifer trees and a few wooden houses scattered among them. The sky is overcast and empty, and there is no visible text or caption on the image side.
